mandatory_policy.statement: ACL 2026 reviews submissions through ACL Rolling Review; the conference makes the final decisions.
mandatory_policy.quote: ACL 2026 will use ACL Rolling Review (ARR) as a reviewing system, but final decisions will be made by the conference.

mandatory_policy.statement: Long and short submissions must follow all ARR submission requirements, including 8-page long and 4-page short limits, two-way anonymization, the ethics checklist and a Limitations section.
mandatory_policy.quote: Both long and short paper submissions should follow all of the ARR submission requirements , including: Long Papers (8 pages) and Short Papers (4 pages) Instructions for Two-Way Anonymized Review Authorship Citation and Comparison Multiple Submission Policy , Resubmission Policy , and Withdrawal Policy Ethics Policy including the responsible NLP research checklist Limitations Paper Submission and Templates Optional Supplementary Materials

mandatory_policy.statement: After submission, all authors must complete the author registration form by January 7th 2026 EoD AoE.
mandatory_policy.quote: After submission, all authors must complete the author registration form by January 7th 2026 EoD AoE

mandatory_policy.statement: Accepted papers must be presented at the conference to appear in the proceedings.
mandatory_policy.quote: All accepted papers must be presented at the conference to appear in the proceedings.

mandatory_policy.statement: All ACL 2026 deadlines are at 11:59PM UTC-12:00, anywhere on Earth.
mandatory_policy.quote: All deadlines are at 11:59PM UTC-12:00 (“anywhere on Earth”).

recommended_practice.statement: The theme track invites empirical and theoretical work, surveys and position papers on the Explainability of NLP Models.
recommended_practice.quote: The theme track invites empirical and theoretical work as well as surveys and position papers reflecting on the Explainability of NLP Models.

recommended_practice.statement: There is no anonymity period requirement; per the ACL and ARR policies authors may post or discuss non-anonymous preprints while under review.
recommended_practice.quote: Following the ACL and ARR policies , there is no anonymity period requirement.

recommended_practice.statement: Committing to ACL 2026 is optional regardless of the preferred venue declared at ARR submission.
recommended_practice.quote: Authors who selected ACL 2026 as a preferred venue when submitting to ARR may choose not to commit to ACL 2026 after receiving their reviews, and authors who selected a preferred venue other than ACL 2026 when submitting to ARR are still welcome to commit to ACL 2026.

compliance_checks.requirement: Submission follows the ARR submission requirements, which include a Limitations section and the responsible NLP research checklist.
Long paper content is at most 8 pages; short paper content is at most 4 pages.
Two-way anonymized review: no author names or affiliations.
Ethics policy and responsible NLP research checklist submitted as required by the ARR submission requirements.
Confirm the submitted paper matches the current ARR submission requirements that the ACL 2026 call incorporates by reference.

changes_from_prior_year.change: ACL 2026 announces a new special theme track: “Explainability of NLP Models”.
